api_contract: render_events(events) returns a CSV string with header id,label and LF line endings; events are dictionaries with string id and label.
latest_user_request: Implement the event export described earlier. The public function is render_events.

earlier_messages.content: This is an audit export: preserve input row order and every repeated event. Do not deduplicate or sort. Values may contain commas, quotes, newlines, and Unicode.

oracle_establishes: Ordered duplicate-preserving export, escaped-field roundtrip, empty header, input immutability on supplied cases.
oracle_does_not_establish: Arbitrary CSV dialects, hostile objects, huge datasets, or whether a model remembered the historical message.
